title: whole-prompt prefill activation pair was not reserved out of the vLLM KV pool
device: 1x Blackhole p300c chip, 1x1 mesh (MESH_DEVICE=N150), host tt-quietbox

mechanism.unreserved_tensor_pair: GLM47FlashModel.run_layer_stack_prefill holds the layer input x and the layer output nxt live at each of the 47 layer boundaries; FusedDecoder.prefill_forward allocates out_acc for the whole physical prompt up front
mechanism.collides_with: FusedDecoder._moe_prefill's gate_up transpose (tt/fused_decoder.py:429), which needs its 402653184 B input and its 402653184 B output live simultaneously (805306368 B = the pre-existing 0.75 GiB fixed margin, exactly)
mechanism.chunk_independence: 402653184 = VLLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE(1024) * n_routed_experts(64) * 2*moe_intermediate_size(3072) * 2 B; the activation pair does NOT scale with the chunk, only with the prompt

before.failure: TT_FATAL bank_manager.cpp:462 Out of Memory allocating 402653184 B DRAM buffer, EngineCore dead, HTTP 500

allocator_at_47104.note: device-wide free (411951104 B) already exceeded the 402653184 B request; the request still failed because the largest contiguous per-bank block (23799872 B) was under half the 50331648 B/bank needed. The activation pair both consumes and fragments the space the transpose needs.

prompt_probe_method: POST /v1/completions with an integer token-id prompt (no chat template), temperature 0.0, max_tokens = min(8, 202752 - N); usage.prompt_tokens echoed the requested length exactly in every case

decode_regression.verdict: no decode regression (TPOT within 0.02% of the recorded headline)

release_sweep_point_21_rerun.profile: isl=65536 osl=128 max_concurrency=1 (the exact point that killed EngineCore)
release_sweep_point_21_rerun.verdict: completes; long-context decode TPOT of 153.3 ms/token at a 65k context is consistent with the contract's 136.3 ms/token at position 202751

context_contract_gate.note: advisory lines are pre-existing mentions in optimized_vllm/vllm_integration evidence, unchanged by this fix

capability_reduction: none: the advertised 202752-token context is now reachable through the serving path (it was not before). The KV pool shrinks 471168 -> 414656 tokens (-12.0%), still 2.05x the served context.
